Care team

Our Doctors

Our cardiology team includes experienced physicians who provide patient-centred cardiac care. Physicians rotate weekly, so the doctor you see may vary.

Whether you are visiting for a diagnostic test, such as an ECG or exercise stress test, or attending a consultation, you will be under the care of one of our attending physicians.
